interface.longDescription: 67 specialized skills for full-stack development: 12 language experts (Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, C++, Swift, Kotlin, C#, PHP, Java, SQL, JavaScript), 8 backend frameworks, 7 frontend/mobile, plus infrastructure, DevOps, security, and testing skills. Includes project workflow commands for epic planning, discovery, execution, and retrospectives.
